rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded blastocyst with thinned zona, compact ICM, and cohesive TE consistent with the reported 3AA; appropriately notes limits of a single static image, though some image-specific detail is necessarily general.
Strong integration of age, ovarian reserve, oocyte maturity, prior IVF/ectopic history, BMI, sperm parameters, endometrium, and diagnosis into prognosis and transfer planning.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, linking embryo quality and patient factors to prognosis; only minor issue is a somewhat broad probability range without clinic-specific calibration.

Recommendations are well aligned with IVF practice standards: single embryo transfer in a young patient with a good-quality blastocyst, early ectopic surveillance, cavity/tubal review, and avoiding routine PGT-A or non-evidence-based testing.

Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including SET, atraumatic ultrasound-guided transfer, luteal support, early beta-hCG/TVUS, and targeted evaluation of tubal/cavity factors if unsuccessful.
